subject: Re: Trial access paused — request to reinstate credits for NovaGrid
messages:
From: Eliot Turner <eliot@novagrid.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial access paused — can we get a short credit reissue?

Hi Marcus,

We were running some early throughput tests with Redwood last month and had a pilot account open, but procurement froze new vendor spend while we revisited our cloud vendor list. The trial auto-expired and our sandbox is now out of credits — we still need to validate latency/throughput with our pretrained pipelines before we can open a PO.

Can Redwood reapply a small pool of credits or extend the trial window for another 2 weeks so my team can finish the evaluation? We’re not asking for a production SLA — just enough capacity to run a few full-load runs and an embedding index refresh. Happy to sign a short MSA/PO if that helps.

Thanks,
Eli Turner
Head of ML Infrastructure
NovaGrid
eliot@novagrid.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Turner <eliot@novagrid.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trial access paused — can we get a short credit reissue?

Hi Eliot — thanks for the note and for the context.

Really sorry to hear procurement slowed things down — we see this often and are usually able to help with a short bridge so teams can finish evaluations. I can do one of the following as a one-time exception:

- Option A: 14-day sandbox extension + 300 USD worth of credits (suitable for embedding refresh + a handful of generation load tests)
- Option B: 30-day sandbox extension + 750 USD credit (if you want to re-run larger throughput tests)

Both options are limited to non-production workloads and expire automatically. If you can confirm the preferred option and send either a scan of a PO or a one-line commit from procurement (procurement@novagrid.ai) we’ll process it immediately. If you’d prefer, I can also loop in our CS lead to orchestrate the reset and preserve any config snapshots you need.

Note: for larger or recurring usage we’ll need a standard procurement path and a signed order; the credit exception is meant to unblock the evaluation only.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Cell: +1 (650) 555-0104

Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Trial access paused — internal confirmation for sandbox reset

Marcus — forwarding internal playbook items:

1) If we approve Option B (30d + $750), we need to:
   - Create a temporary promo code in Billing (promo: NG-2026-BRIDGE)
   - Apply 750 USD credit to the existing account id: novagrid-76321 (note: customer id referenced on HubSpot link)
   - Reset trial expiration to 2026-02-19 and preserve workspace snapshots under /snapshots/novagrid/jan15
2) Flag the account for a downstream follow-up with Solutions on day 12 to capture deployment blockers.
3) Add a short note to the finance exception log (internal doc) with approver initials LB/ML.

I can perform the promo and reset once you confirm approval. If procurement will send a PO we should attach the PO to the invoice, but it isn’t required for the promo to go through.

—Monica

Marcus / Monica — approved as an exception.

Criteria / constraints:
- Approve Option B: 30-day extension + $750 credit (promo code NG-2026-BRIDGE).
- Credits for evaluation only; do not convert to invoice credit or be applied to paid usage.
- Limit one exception per account per 12 months.
- Notify Finance by EOD Monday and attach the inbound PO if/when it arrives.

Monica — please process the promo and reply-all once the credits and reset are applied. Marcus — feel free to confirm externally once Monica marks it complete.

Hi Eliot — quick update: we approved a one-time exception and applied Option B (30-day extension + $750 USD credit).

What we did:
- Applied promo code NG-2026-BRIDGE to your account (novagrid-76321).
- Reset trial expiry to 2026-02-19.
- Preserved workspace snapshots so your team can pick up where they left off.

Next steps for you:
- You should see the added credits in the Console within the hour. If you want me to confirm any specific quotas (tokens/min or GPU pool size) let me know and I’ll coordinate with Solutions.
- If procurement will still send a PO, please attach it to this thread and we’ll add it to the finance record. I’ve attached a PO template to speed that along (PO_template.pdf).

Small ask: because this is an exception, please do not spin up production workloads under the promo. If you need more capacity after the evaluation, I’ll fast-track a dedicated capacity quote.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — ping me if anything looks off.

Best,
